email.subject: Quick fix for Smile Dentistry's site
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I checked Smile Dentistry's site. Three photos are unresized originals (9-10MB each), so on mobile data the page can take 10+ seconds to load — most visitors leave before it does. On top of that, the site isn't set up for phones, so anyone searching from their phone (most dental searches) gets a page that's hard to tap or read. There's also no listed hours, so people can't tell if you're open before calling.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's costing you patients?

Alex
Northlight Web
